elements.name: Mediation without bypass
elements.statement: Every in-scope consequential action crosses the Enforcement Boundary before its effect, no undisclosed path goes around it, and the governed AI system can neither rewrite, disable nor bypass enforcement.

elements.name: A decision the governed AI system cannot change
elements.statement: Policy outside the governed AI system decides. Inputs whose asserted values the system can produce or overwrite without independent validation, or whose authenticity or transition checks it can modify or bypass, and judgments about meaning or risk, can only make an outcome stricter and are never the basis of an admit. An independently validated state transition does not by itself make the resulting authoritative observation actor-supplied. The control plane is independent of the governed AI system.

elements.name: Failure ends closed
elements.statement: Missing proof, integrity failure, policy ambiguity and the loss of a required dependency end in denial, restricted mode or halt.

elements.name: Bounded, revocable authority
elements.statement: Authority is typed, transaction-bound, time-bounded and revocable, and each delegation hop preserves or narrows it.

elements.name: Evidence a third party can check
elements.statement: Each decision and action leaves tamper-evident evidence, including the inputs the decision rested on; from L2 it is independently verifiable outside the primary control plane.

elements.name: Declared scope and claim boundary
elements.statement: A claim states which actions and paths are in scope, which are excluded, its level, independence class and assessment, so that no reader takes it to cover more.

elements.name: Operations that keep it true
elements.statement: Revocation within a declared timing case, an emergency control plane, detections that act on decisions, verification of the controls and reviewed changes keep the other elements true over time.
